points.point: 市場需求端：5G FWA operator 的 Rel.16 需求包含 mmWave 載波聚合由 4CC/8CC 擴到 10CC，以及吞吐由 7.9 Gbps 提升到 10 Gbps、FR1+FR2 ENDC 轉為 DC/CA
points.label: missing
points.why: does not mention 5G FWA Rel.16, 4CC/8CC→10CC, 7.9→10 Gbps, or ENDC→DC/CA

points.point: 市場需求被轉成 RF parametric 可量測參數：Output power、EVM、OBW、receiver sensitivity level BLER、band permutations and CAs（多為 operator 要求）
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions some parameters such as output power, EVM, OBW, receiver sensitivity, but omits BLER and band permutations/CAs as operator RF parametric requirements

points.point: 這些測試需求對應到的儀器類別明確包含 VSA（signal analyzer）與 VSG（signal generator），具體型號為 R&S FSW 與 R&S SMW200A
points.label: covered
points.why: explicitly maps to signal generator/analyzer and names R&S SMW200A and R&S FSW

points.point: 基地台側的可量測參數清單來自 3GPP TS 38.141-1 chapter 6，含 Modulation quality、Occupied bandwidth、ACLR 等 transmitted signal quality 與 unwanted emissions 項目
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions modulation quality, OBW, ACLR and emissions, but not clearly as 3GPP TS 38.141-1 chapter 6 transmitted-signal-quality/unwanted-emissions list

points.point: 參數 → signal analyzer 能力：ACLR（6.6.3）需要 FSW base unit 加 FSW-K144 5G NR option，並在 5G NR mode 以 Channel Power ACLR / EVM 量測功能執行；OBW 則用 spectrum analyzer mode 基本功能
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions FSW and K144 for analyzer measurements, but omits the specific ACLR Channel Power ACLR/EVM execution and OBW in spectrum analyzer mode

points.point: 參數 → signal generator 能力：receiver 類參數（Dynamic range、ACS、blocking、intermodulation）需要 SMW200A 配 2× baseband generator、baseband main module B13T/B13XT、兩條 RF path、AWGN option K62 與 2× K144
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions SMW200A, AWGN and some NR options, but not the required receiver-test setup: 2× baseband generator, B13T/B13XT, two RF paths, K62 and 2× K144

points.point: 頻寬需求（FR2 test model 100/200/400 MHz 與寬頻 CA）決定硬體能力門檻：signal generator 需 wideband baseband（SMW-B13XT）提供 up to 2 GHz RF modulation bandwidth
points.label: partial
points.why: states SMW200A can reach 2 GHz RF modulation bandwidth with wideband baseband, but omits FR2 100/200/400 MHz and wideband CA framing and SMW-B13XT

points.point: 對應地 signal analyzer 需加購 analysis bandwidth 硬體選項（例如 FSW-B2001 提供 2 GHz analysis bandwidth）才能涵蓋寬頻訊號分析
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions FSW analysis bandwidth options, but not the specific requirement to add hardware such as FSW-B2001 for 2 GHz analysis bandwidth

invented: OTA transmitter metrics include EIRP, TRP, transmitter OFF power, frequency error, EVM, TAE, OBW, ACLR, unwanted emissions, spurious emissions, and intermodulation
FSW-K544 is used for OTA calibration with SMW-K544
5G NR Base Station OTA TX Tests source GFM324 is cited as ingested evidence
